abstract: [SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT] A fictional review of condition families that can present as acute respiratory illness. It gives context for a verifier and does not allow a diagnosis from reported counts.

excerpts.text: Reported acute respiratory illness counts are a syndromic signal and not a diagnosis; clinical and laboratory assessment is needed.
Viral and bacterial infection families are associated with acute respiratory illness.
